title: A UV–visible spectrum
caption: Tetraamminecopper(II), [Cu(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]²⁺, absorbs most strongly at about 600 nm (orange), so it appears deep blue. At λmax, absorbance A = εcl (the Beer–Lambert law), which is why concentrations are measured there.
alt: Absorbance against wavelength from 400 to 800 nm: a broad peak at 600 nm.
description: A broad absorption band peaking at 600 nm.
Little absorption below 450 nm, which is why blue light is transmitted.
